title: 欢迎来到星天  (Welcome to Xingtian)

segments.t: Bu Xiaogu arrives for her first day at Xingtian Entertainment. Producer Wang Er welcomes her and takes her through the control room to Studio One, where Twelve Singers is taping. Listen first.
王尔老师，您好！
欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。
是十二歌王吗？
那当然了，咱们走。
这边是导播室，所有的信号都传到这儿来。
这就是一号棚，星天的门面。
从建成到现在，一天都没有停。
现在是不是十二歌王开始了？
慢点，小心别摔倒了！
Let's walk through the tour together. Xiaogu greets her new mentor politely at the entrance.
王尔老师，您好！
'Hello, Teacher Wang Er!' In Chinese, media and creative teams, people routinely address seasoned seniors as "laoshi", 'teacher', as a mark of respect, paired with polite "nin hao".
欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。

'Welcome to Xingtian; they are taping right at this moment.' Wrapping an action in "zhengzai... ne" is the clearest way to say something is happening right now, while "zhehuir" means 'at this moment'.
是十二歌王吗？
'Is it Twelve Singers?' Take any statement with "shi", 'is', and drop "ma" onto the end to turn it into a clean yes-or-no question without changing word order.
那当然了，咱们走。
'Of course it is — let's go.' Warm "na dangran le" means 'well, of course!', and northern speakers love "zanmen zou" — 'we' including the listener, plus 'go'.
这边是导播室，所有的信号都传到这儿来。

'Over here is the control room; every signal comes through to here.' Notice the pairing "suoyou de... dou", literally 'all of... every one': Mandarin keeps "dou", 'all', before the action even after saying 'all signals'.
这就是一号棚，星天的门面。
'This right here is Studio One, the showcase of Xingtian.' Calling a studio the company's "menmian" literally calls it the 'shopfront' or 'face' — the flagship space everyone sees first.
从建成到现在，一天都没有停。
'From the day it was built until now, it has not stopped for a single day.' Using "yitian dou meiyou", literally 'even one day not', is the standard way to express 'not even a single day'.
现在是不是十二歌王开始了？
'Is Twelve Singers starting right now?' Eager "xianzai", 'right now', plus "shi bu shi" asks for confirmation of something the speaker can already hear starting on stage.
慢点，小心别摔倒了！

'Slow down — be careful not to trip and fall!' Remember two everyday warnings in one breath: "man dian" for 'slow down a bit', and "xiaoxin", literally 'small heart', for 'be careful'. Now listen to the whole Studio One tour again.
王尔老师，您好！
欢迎来到星天，这会儿正在录像呢。
是十二歌王吗？
那当然了，咱们走。
这边是导播室，所有的信号都传到这儿来。
这就是一号棚，星天的门面。
从建成到现在，一天都没有停。
现在是不是十二歌王开始了？
慢点，小心别摔倒了！

Studio One is already buzzing with live cameras, and Xiaogu jumps straight in to lend a hand backstage. You learned how to welcome someone with "huanying laidao" and warn a friend with "man dian, xiaoxin".
再见！
